name: Hanasaki Akane
source:
Likes: Comedy (owarai), messing around with people
Dislikes: People who don't understand puns

Akane is the most cheerful, stylish and bustiest girl from the "Setsugekka" trio. [url=/c4049]Koko[/url] and [url=/c4052]Anzu[/url] are her best friends. Akane loves to tease Koko, especially with regards to [url=/c4059]Yoshiyuki[/url]. However Yoshiyuki often finds himself in a much more complicated situation, because not only does Akane teases him, she also flirts with him. At the same time, she is a warm and caring friend to those close to her. But there are some contradictions in her behavior. She may hide some kind of terrible secret...
